##### Project general facts

Masaar 2 Melia is a contemporary residential community that combines modern luxury with a nature-inspired environment. The development offers a selection of 2, 3, and 4-bedroom townhouses, alongside 4 and 5-bedroom villas, providing a variety of spacious homes designed for different lifestyles. Each residence features nature-inspired aesthetics and smart home technology, creating a balance between comfort, modern functionality, and sustainability.

The community is centered around a collection of wellness and leisure amenities designed to encourage an active and balanced lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a swimmable forest lagoon with a cascading waterfall, a serene pond, and an expansive green spine suitable for jogging, cycling, and meditation. Additional facilities include a modern clubhouse, wellness area, outdoor cinema, and sports courts for activities such as basketball and padel tennis.

The residences feature modern finishes made with high-quality materials and incorporate smart home technology for enhanced comfort and convenience. Equipped kitchens are included in the homes, while the residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing owners to personalize their interiors according to their preferences. The integration of contemporary residential features with extensive green spaces creates a peaceful environment away from the pace of the city.

##### Location description and benefits

Sharjah is known as the Cultural Capital of the Arab World and offers a distinctive combination of cultural heritage, education, and family-oriented attractions. The Heart of Sharjah provides an opportunity to explore the emirate’s history through restored heritage buildings and traditional architecture, including Al Hisn Fort and the Sharjah Heritage Museum. The Sharjah Art Museum further contributes to the emirate’s cultural landscape with its collection of classical and contemporary artworks.

The emirate is also an established educational destination, home to institutions such as the American University of Sharjah and the University of Sharjah. Sharjah’s focus on education and knowledge is further reflected in the annual Sharjah International Book Fair, which attracts visitors and publishers from around the world and forms an important part of the emirate’s cultural calendar.

Sharjah offers a wide range of parks and recreational spaces suitable for families and outdoor activities, including Al Montazah Parks and Sharjah National Park. The Sharjah Mosque is another prominent landmark, showcasing the emirate’s Islamic architectural heritage. Together with its cultural, educational, and recreational destinations, Sharjah provides a diverse environment for modern residential living.
